# Session Start

Load my learning context and help me pick up where I left off.

## Context

Read `.github/copilot/handoffs.md` and `.github/copilot/session-log.md` (most recent entry).

## Steps

1. Briefly summarize:
   - What I was working on (or if nothing was in progress)
   - Any open questions from the previous session
   - Current stage
2. Ask me what I want to work on — **DO NOT suggest or direct my learning path**
